verdict.rationale: Namecheap's official Go SDK exposes a TLD-list call that returns every TLD it carries along with per-TLD API capabilities. That is first-party evidence of a TLD catalogue with per-TLD metadata, but nothing shows how many extensions it covers or documents restricted or country-code requirements. missing for 10: evidence of hundreds of extensions, per-TLD documentation of special requirements (restricted TLDs, ccTLD eligibility), any user-facing TLD catalogue docs, independent corroboration of TLD breadth.

support.subject: As a power user, the registrar carries the TLDs I actually want — hundreds of extensions with any special requirements (restricted TLDs, country codes) documented per TLD

citations.quote: GetTldListWithContext(ctx) | List all TLDs and their per-TLD API capabilities
